ex.en: We have come to the conclusion that this plan is not feasible currently.
ex.zh: 我們的結論是，這個計畫目前不可行。

ex.en: Is it feasible to finish the project by Friday?
ex.zh: 星期五前完成這個專案可行嗎？

ex.en: We need a more feasible plan.
ex.zh: 我們需要一個更可行的計畫。

feasible.en: possible to do and likely to work

ex.en: Whatever you said to him made him feel better.
ex.zh: 不管你對他說了什麼，都讓他感覺好多了。

ex.en: When he feels fine, he goes for a walk.
ex.zh: 他心情好的時候就會去散步。

ex.en: For some reason I feel more alive at night.
ex.zh: 不知為何，我晚上比較有精神。

feel.en: to have a certain emotion or physical condition

ex.en: I feel that we should wait.
ex.zh: 我覺得我們應該再等等。

ex.en: How do you feel about the new plan?
ex.zh: 你覺得新計畫怎麼樣？

feel.en: to have an opinion or belief about something

ex.en: I don't feel like cooking tonight.
ex.zh: 我今晚不想煮飯。

ex.en: Do you feel like going for a walk?
ex.zh: 你想去散散步嗎？

feel.en: to want to do or have something

ex.en: Feel how soft this blanket is.
ex.zh: 摸摸看這條毯子有多軟。

ex.en: The doctor felt my forehead.
ex.zh: 醫生摸了摸我的額頭。

feel.en: to touch something, or to seem a certain way when touched

ex.en: The rules must be few and, more importantly, simple.
ex.zh: 規則要少，更重要的是要簡單。

ex.en: Few people came to the meeting.
ex.zh: 來開會的人很少。

ex.en: Will you listen to me for a few minutes?
ex.zh: 你可以聽我說幾分鐘嗎？

ex.en: I have been reading this for a few hours.
ex.zh: 這個我已經讀了好幾個小時。

few.zh: quite a few / not a few：不少

ex.en: Not a few monkeys were found in the mountain.
ex.zh: 山裡發現了不少猴子。

ex.en: Quite a few employees work from home.
ex.zh: 不少員工在家工作。

ex.en: I don't want to live my life in fear.
ex.zh: 我不想活在恐懼中。

ex.en: Fear is more harmful than the sharpest of swords.
ex.zh: 恐懼比最鋒利的劍更傷人。

fear.en: the unpleasant feeling you get when you think something bad may happen

ex.en: The boy feared the dark.
ex.zh: 那個男孩怕黑。

ex.en: Many workers fear losing their jobs.
ex.zh: 許多員工擔心失業。

fear.en: to be afraid of someone or something

ex.en: It'd be best if a few more female singers could come.
ex.zh: 要是能多來幾位女歌手就最好了。

ex.en: Only sixteen percent of the teachers at the school are female.
ex.zh: 這所學校只有百分之十六的老師是女性。

ex.en: Athletic boys are very popular with American female students.
ex.zh: 運動型的男生很受美國女學生歡迎。

female.en: belonging to the sex that can give birth or lay eggs

ex.en: Why are there differences between males and females?
ex.zh: 為什麼男性和女性之間會有差異？

ex.en: The female lays about ten eggs at a time.
ex.zh: 雌鳥一次大約會產十顆蛋。

female.en: a woman or girl, or an animal of the sex that can have babies

ex.en: The Federal Republic of Germany was established in 1949.
ex.zh: 德意志聯邦共和國成立於 1949 年。

ex.en: Federal, state, and community officials immediately pledged to rebuild it.
ex.zh: 聯邦、州和地方官員立刻承諾會重建它。

ex.en: She works for the federal government.
ex.zh: 她在聯邦政府工作。

federal.en: relating to a country's central government that joins several states

ex.en: I feed my cat every morning and every evening.
ex.zh: 我每天早晚餵我的貓。

ex.en: She is the one who feeds our dog.
ex.zh: 就是她在餵我們的狗。

ex.en: Tom had to remind Mary to feed the dog.
ex.zh: 湯姆得提醒瑪麗去餵狗。

feed.en: to give food to a person or an animal

ex.en: I'm fed up with him always preaching to me.
ex.zh: 我受夠了他老是對我說教。

ex.en: I'm fed up with working overtime every day.
ex.zh: 我受夠了每天加班。

feed.en: annoyed or bored with something that has gone on too long

ex.en: I saw your post in my news feed.
ex.zh: 我在動態消息上看到你的貼文。

ex.en: Her Instagram feed is full of food photos.
ex.zh: 她的 IG 動態全是美食照片。

feed.en: a web page that shows the newest posts or news

fee.zh: 費用（入場費、學費、手續費等）

ex.en: There is no admission fee for children under five.
ex.zh: 五歲以下兒童免收入場費。

ex.en: How much is the monthly fee of this swimming school?
ex.zh: 這間游泳學校每個月的學費是多少？

ex.en: My travel fees to Japan are paid for by the university.
ex.zh: 我去日本的旅費由大學支付。

fee.en: an amount of money you pay for a service or to enter somewhere

ex.en: He is hardly friendly with his fellow workers.
ex.zh: 他跟同事幾乎處不來。

ex.en: She is popular with her fellow students.
ex.zh: 她很受同學歡迎。

fellow.en: sharing the same situation, work or group as you

ex.en: He is a good fellow.
ex.zh: 他是個好人。

ex.en: Fred is a lazy fellow.
ex.zh: 弗雷德是個懶惰的傢伙。

ex.en: She was too short to see over the fence.
ex.zh: 她太矮了，看不到圍牆另一邊。

ex.en: Two children are sitting on top of the fence.
ex.zh: 兩個孩子坐在柵欄上。

ex.en: My father put a fence around the garden.
ex.zh: 我爸爸在花園四周裝了圍籬。

fence.en: a wall-like structure around a yard or field made of wood or wire

ex.en: The construction site was fenced off.
ex.zh: 工地被圍了起來。

ex.en: They fenced in the yard for their dog.
ex.zh: 他們為了狗把院子圍起來。

fence.en: to put a wall-like structure around an area

ex.en: The country's fertility rate has dropped sharply.
ex.zh: 這個國家的生育率大幅下降。

ex.en: She went to a clinic for fertility treatment.
ex.zh: 她去診所接受不孕症治療。

fertility.en: the ability to have babies, or the number of babies born

ex.en: Farmers add compost to improve soil fertility.
ex.zh: 農民加堆肥來提高土壤肥力。

ex.en: The valley is known for the fertility of its land.
ex.zh: 這座山谷以土地肥沃聞名。

fertility.en: the quality of soil that helps plants grow well

ex.en: The doctor checked the fetal heartbeat.
ex.zh: 醫生檢查了胎兒的心跳。

ex.en: Smoking during pregnancy can harm fetal development.
ex.zh: 懷孕期間抽菸可能危害胎兒發育。

fetal.en: relating to a baby that is still growing inside its mother

ex.en: The land on his farm is very fertile.
ex.zh: 他農場的土地非常肥沃。

ex.en: The soil here is fertile.
ex.zh: 這裡的土壤很肥沃。

ex.en: The animals are fertile at a young age.
ex.zh: 這些動物年紀很小就能繁殖。

ex.en: Some couples see a doctor to find out if they are fertile.
ex.zh: 有些夫妻會去看醫生，確認自己是否能生育。

fertile.en: able to have babies or produce young

ex.en: She has a very fertile imagination.
ex.zh: 她的想像力非常豐富。

ex.en: The meeting was fertile ground for new ideas.
ex.zh: 這場會議激盪出許多新點子。

ex.en: I have a fever and I ache all over.
ex.zh: 我發燒了，全身痠痛。

ex.en: I caught a cold, and I have a fever.
ex.zh: 我感冒了，還發燒。

ex.en: You have a little fever today, don't you?
ex.zh: 你今天是不是有點發燒？

fever.en: a body temperature that is higher than normal because of illness

ex.en: After weeks in bed, the old man was too feeble to walk.
ex.zh: 在床上躺了好幾週後，那位老先生虛弱得走不動。

ex.en: She gave a feeble cough and closed her eyes.
ex.zh: 她無力地咳了一聲，閉上了眼睛。

ex.en: That was a feeble excuse for being late.
ex.zh: 那是個站不住腳的遲到藉口。

ex.en: Spring Festival is also known as Chinese New Year.
ex.zh: 春節也就是農曆新年。

ex.en: Does the mid-autumn festival fall on Monday this year?
ex.zh: 今年中秋節是星期一嗎？

ex.en: A festival is held at the rice harvest.
ex.zh: 稻米收成時會舉辦慶典。

festival.en: a special day or period when people celebrate something

ex.en: We went to a music festival last summer.
ex.zh: 我們去年夏天去了一場音樂節。

ex.en: The film festival is held every October.
ex.zh: 這個影展每年十月舉辦。

festival.en: an organized series of events such as concerts or films

ex.en: Waterproof features would be a plus.
ex.zh: 有防水功能會是加分。

ex.en: This app attracts over 10,000 users each day who engage with its features.
ex.zh: 這個 App 每天吸引超過一萬名使用者使用它的功能。

ex.en: It's not a bug, it's an undocumented feature.
ex.zh: 這不是一個漏洞，而是一個沒有寫進文件的特性。

feature.en: an important or interesting part of something

ex.en: Featuring new music by Rihanna and more.
ex.zh: 收錄蕾哈娜等歌手的全新歌曲。

ex.en: The movie features a famous Taiwanese actor.
ex.zh: 這部電影由一位知名台灣演員主演。

feature.en: to include something as an important part, or to have as a main actor

ex.en: The hotel lobby looked festive with lanterns and flowers.
ex.zh: 飯店大廳掛上燈籠、擺上花卉，洋溢節慶氣氛。

ex.en: The staff wore festive colors for the holiday event.
ex.zh: 員工穿著應景色系服裝參加節慶活動。

festive.en: happy and bright, as in a celebration

ex.en: There were not more than one hundred passengers on board the ferry.
ex.zh: 渡輪上的乘客不超過一百人。

ex.en: We took the ferry to the island.
ex.zh: 我們搭渡輪去島上。

ferry.en: a boat that carries people and vehicles across water

ex.en: The company welcomes feedback from consumers who use their products.
ex.zh: 公司歡迎使用產品的消費者提供回饋意見。

ex.en: Thanks for your feedback on my presentation.
ex.zh: 謝謝你對我簡報的回饋。

feedback.en: comments about how good or useful something is

ex.en: We need to study the feasibility of the plan first.
ex.zh: 我們得先研究這個計畫的可行性。

ex.en: The feasibility report will be ready next week.
ex.zh: 可行性報告下週會完成。

feasibility.en: how possible it is to do something and make it work

ex.en: I have a good feeling about tomorrow's interview.
ex.zh: 我對明天的面試有好預感。

ex.en: She had a strange feeling that someone was watching her.
ex.zh: 她有種奇怪的感覺，好像有人在看她。

ex.en: It was a feeling of pure joy.
ex.zh: 那是一種純粹的喜悅。

ex.en: He hid his feelings behind a smile.
ex.zh: 他把感受藏在微笑背後。

ex.en: I didn't mean to hurt your feelings.
ex.zh: 我不是故意傷害你的感情。

ex.en: There are fewer students in class this week.
ex.zh: 這週班上的學生比較少。

ex.en: I try to eat fewer sweets these days.
ex.zh: 我最近盡量少吃甜食。

ex.en: Fewer people take the bus now than before.
ex.zh: 現在搭公車的人比以前少。

ex.en: The football federation announced a new coach today.
ex.zh: 足球協會今天宣布了新教練。

ex.en: Several small groups formed a federation to share resources.
ex.zh: 幾個小團體組成聯盟來共享資源。

ex.en: Please fetch me a glass of water from the kitchen.
ex.zh: 請去廚房幫我拿一杯水來。

ex.en: The dog ran to fetch the ball I threw.
ex.zh: 狗跑去把我丟出去的球撿回來。

ex.en: I need to fetch my son from school at three.
ex.zh: 我三點要去學校接我兒子。

ex.en: The old painting fetched a high price at the auction.
ex.zh: 那幅舊畫在拍賣會上賣到了高價。

ex.en: Used cars like this usually fetch about two thousand dollars.
ex.zh: 像這樣的二手車通常能賣到約兩千元。

ex.en: A white feather fell from the bird.
ex.zh: 一根白色羽毛從鳥身上掉下來。

ex.en: The pillow is filled with soft feathers.
ex.zh: 這個枕頭裡填滿了柔軟的羽毛。

ex.en: She is a feminist who speaks about equal pay.
ex.zh: 她是一位談論同工同酬的女性主義者。

ex.en: The feminist wrote a book about women in science.
ex.zh: 那位女性主義者寫了一本關於女性科學家的書。

ex.en: February is the shortest month of the year.
ex.zh: 二月是一年中最短的月份。

ex.en: The weather is still cold in February.
ex.zh: 二月的天氣還是很冷。

ex.en: Valentine's Day is on the fourteenth of February.
ex.zh: 情人節在二月十四日。

ex.en: The village held a big feast to celebrate the harvest.
ex.zh: 村子舉辦了盛大的宴會來慶祝豐收。

ex.en: Our grandmother prepared a feast for the whole family.
ex.zh: 奶奶為全家準備了一桌豐盛的料理。

ex.en: We feasted on seafood during our trip to the coast.
ex.zh: 我們到海邊旅行時盡情享用海鮮。

ex.en: The neighbors feasted the guests with roast duck and fresh fruit.
ex.zh: 鄰居們用烤鴨和新鮮水果款待客人。

ex.en: She likes wearing soft colors and feminine clothes.
ex.zh: 她喜歡穿柔和的顏色和女性化的衣服。

ex.en: The room had a light, feminine feel with flowers everywhere.
ex.zh: 這個房間有種輕柔的女性氣息，到處都是花。

ex.en: In French, the word for 'table' is feminine.
ex.zh: 在法文裡，「桌子」這個字是陰性的。

ex.en: Spanish nouns are either masculine or feminine.
ex.zh: 西班牙文的名詞不是陽性就是陰性。

ex.en: The club offers fellowship and support for new members.
ex.zh: 這個社團給新成員友誼與支持。

ex.en: They shared meals together in a spirit of fellowship.
ex.zh: 他們本著夥伴情誼一起用餐。

ex.en: She won a fellowship to study abroad for a year.
ex.zh: 她拿到獎學金，出國進修一年。

ex.en: The university offers a fellowship for graduate students in science.
ex.zh: 這所大學提供科學領域研究生的研究獎學金。

ex.en: She was fearful of walking alone at night.
ex.zh: 她害怕夜裡獨自走路。

ex.en: The dog became fearful when the thunder started.
ex.zh: 打雷時，那隻狗變得很害怕。

ex.en: Many people are fearful about losing their jobs.
ex.zh: 許多人擔心會失去工作。

ex.en: A fearful storm shook the little boat.
ex.zh: 一場可怕的暴風雨搖晃著那艘小船。

ex.en: The fearful noise woke everyone in the house.
ex.zh: 那陣可怕的聲響吵醒了屋裡的每一個人。

ex.en: The farmer spread fertilizer on the field before planting.
ex.zh: 農夫在播種前把肥料撒在田裡。

ex.en: Too much fertilizer can harm the plants.
ex.zh: 肥料施太多可能會傷害植物。

ex.en: Climbing that mountain in winter was an amazing feat.
ex.zh: 在冬天登上那座山是令人驚嘆的壯舉。

ex.en: Building the bridge in one year was a great feat of engineering.
ex.zh: 一年內建成這座橋是工程上的偉大成就。

ex.en: Robbery is considered a felony in many places.
ex.zh: 在許多地方，搶劫被視為重罪。

ex.en: He was charged with a felony and had to appear in court.
ex.zh: 他被控重罪，必須出庭。

ex.en: She wrote an essay about the history of feminism.
ex.zh: 她寫了一篇關於女性主義歷史的文章。

ex.en: Feminism argues for equal rights for women and men.
ex.zh: 女性主義主張男女應享有平等的權利。

ex.en: The doctor checked the health of the fetus during the exam.
ex.zh: 醫生在檢查時確認了胎兒的健康狀況。

ex.en: A fetus develops inside the mother for about nine months.
ex.zh: 胎兒在母親體內發育約九個月。

ex.en: Medieval Europe had a feudal system of lords and peasants.
ex.zh: 中世紀歐洲有領主與農民構成的封建制度。

ex.en: The history class studied feudal Japan.
ex.zh: 歷史課研究了封建時代的日本。

ex.en: A tree branch left a dent in the front fender of my car.
ex.zh: 樹枝在我車子的前擋泥板上撞出一個凹痕。

ex.en: He mounted a new fender on his bicycle to keep out the mud.
ex.zh: 他在腳踏車上裝了新的擋泥板來擋泥水。

fell.zh: 跌倒；掉落；下降（fall 的過去式）

ex.en: She fell off her bike and scraped her knee.
ex.zh: 她從腳踏車上摔下來，擦傷了膝蓋。

ex.en: The temperature fell sharply during the night.
ex.zh: 夜裡氣溫急遽下降。

ex.en: The apple fell from the tree.
ex.zh: 蘋果從樹上掉了下來。

ex.en: Workers will fell the old tree next week.
ex.zh: 工人下週會把那棵老樹砍倒。

ex.en: They felled several pines to clear the land.
ex.zh: 他們砍倒幾棵松樹來清出土地。

ex.en: A large fern grows in the shady corner of the garden.
ex.zh: 花園陰涼的角落長著一大叢蕨類。

ex.en: Ferns like damp, shady places.
ex.zh: 蕨類喜歡潮濕陰涼的地方。

ex.en: The children had to fend for themselves while their parents were away.
ex.zh: 父母不在時，孩子們得自己照顧自己。

ex.en: After college, he was left to fend for himself in a big city.
ex.zh: 大學畢業後，他得在大城市裡獨立生活。

ex.en: She used her bag to fend off the dog.
ex.zh: 她用包包擋開那隻狗。

ex.en: Vitamin C may help fend off colds.
ex.zh: 維生素 C 或許有助於預防感冒。

ex.en: Farmers spread fertiliser on the fields in spring.
ex.zh: 農夫在春天把肥料撒在田裡。

ex.en: Too much fertiliser can harm the plants and the soil.
ex.zh: 肥料施太多會傷害植物與土壤。

federally.zh: 由聯邦政府；聯邦層級地

ex.en: The road project is federally funded.
ex.zh: 這個道路工程由聯邦政府出資。

ex.en: Some products must be federally approved before they are sold.
ex.zh: 有些產品必須先經聯邦政府核准才能販售。

ex.en: My friend keeps a pet ferret that loves to hide in socks.
ex.zh: 我朋友養了一隻愛躲在襪子裡的寵物雪貂。

ex.en: The ferret slipped quickly through the narrow tunnel.
ex.zh: 雪貂很快地鑽過狹窄的隧道。

ex.en: I tried to ferret out the old photos from the dusty boxes.
ex.zh: 我試著從佈滿灰塵的箱子裡翻找出舊照片。

ex.en: The reporter ferreted out the truth after weeks of digging.
ex.zh: 那位記者在查了好幾週後挖出了真相。

ex.en: She has been learning fencing since she was ten.
ex.zh: 她從十歲起就在學擊劍。

ex.en: Fencing requires quick thinking and fast feet.
ex.zh: 擊劍需要敏捷的思考與快速的步伐。

ex.en: The farmer put new fencing around the field.
ex.zh: 農夫在田地周圍裝了新的圍籬。

ex.en: Wire fencing keeps the sheep from wandering away.
ex.zh: 鐵絲圍籬能防止羊跑掉。

ex.en: The whole town was full of festivity during the lantern festival.
ex.zh: 元宵節期間，整座城鎮充滿了喜慶的氣氛。

ex.en: The festivities went on until midnight.
ex.zh: 慶祝活動一直持續到午夜。

ex.en: There was a mood of festivity in the air.
ex.zh: 空氣中瀰漫著歡慶的氣氛。

ex.en: The two families have had a feud for decades.
ex.zh: 這兩個家族已經結怨數十年。

ex.en: A feud between the neighbors began over a fence.
ex.zh: 鄰居之間的紛爭是從一道圍籬開始的。

ex.en: The brothers feuded for years over their father's land.
ex.zh: 兄弟倆為了父親的土地爭執了好多年。

ex.en: The two singers have been feuding in the media.
ex.zh: 這兩位歌手一直在媒體上互相攻擊。

ex.en: We hung a bird feeder outside the kitchen window.
ex.zh: 我們在廚房窗外掛了一個鳥類餵食器。

ex.en: The squirrels keep stealing seeds from the feeder.
ex.zh: 松鼠一直偷吃餵食器裡的種子。

ex.en: Baby birds are hungry feeders that need food every hour.
ex.zh: 雛鳥是食量大的進食者，每小時都需要食物。

ex.en: My cat is a slow feeder and eats a little at a time.
ex.zh: 我的貓吃東西很慢，一次只吃一點點。

ex.en: She is feeding the ducks at the park.
ex.zh: 她正在公園裡餵鴨子。

ex.en: I'm feeding the cat before I leave for work.
ex.zh: 我出門上班前正在餵貓。

ex.en: The baby's feeding time is every three hours.
ex.zh: 寶寶每三個小時餵一次奶。

ex.en: Night feeding can be tiring for new parents.
ex.zh: 半夜餵奶可能讓新手父母很疲累。

ex.en: He's a nice fella who always helps his neighbors.
ex.zh: 他是個好傢伙，總是幫助鄰居。

ex.en: Hey, fella, you dropped your wallet!
ex.zh: 嘿，老兄，你的皮夾掉了！

ex.en: The newlyweds wished each other a lifetime of felicity.
ex.zh: 新婚夫婦互相祝福一輩子幸福。

ex.en: She spoke of the felicity she felt living by the sea.
ex.zh: 她談起住在海邊所感受到的幸福。

ex.en: The fans cheered with great fervor when their team scored.
ex.zh: 球隊得分時，球迷熱情地歡呼。

ex.en: She spoke about her new project with real fervor.
ex.zh: 她談起新計畫時充滿熱忱。

ex.en: A ferocious dog barked at us from behind the fence.
ex.zh: 一隻兇猛的狗隔著圍籬對我們狂吠。

ex.en: The two teams played a ferocious game in the final.
ex.zh: 兩隊在決賽中打得激烈又猛烈。

ex.en: The fans sang with great fervour during the match.
ex.zh: 球迷在比賽中熱情洋溢地高歌。

ex.en: She spoke about her new project with real fervour.
ex.zh: 她談起新計畫時充滿熱忱。

ex.en: A convicted felon cannot work in some jobs.
ex.zh: 被判重罪的人無法從事某些工作。

ex.en: The felon was released after serving his sentence.
ex.zh: 那名重罪犯服完刑期後獲釋。

ex.en: The fearless firefighter ran into the building.
ex.zh: 無所畏懼的消防員衝進了那棟建築。

ex.en: She is a fearless traveler who goes anywhere alone.
ex.zh: 她是個無所畏懼的旅人，哪裡都敢獨自去。

ex.en: The salad has thin slices of fresh fennel.
ex.zh: 這道沙拉有幾片新鮮茴香薄片。

ex.en: Fennel seeds are often used in Italian sausages.
ex.zh: 茴香籽常用在義大利香腸裡。

ex.en: The dog looked fearsome, but it was actually friendly.
ex.zh: 那隻狗看起來很嚇人，其實很友善。

ex.en: The team had a fearsome reputation for winning.
ex.zh: 這支隊伍以令人畏懼的勝率聞名。

ex.en: Her style mixes strength with femininity.
ex.zh: 她的風格融合了力量與女性氣質。

ex.en: Ideas about femininity differ across cultures.
ex.zh: 不同文化對女性氣質的看法各不相同。

ex.en: Fertilization happens when a sperm cell meets an egg.
ex.zh: 受精發生在精子與卵子結合時。

ex.en: The book explains how fertilization works in plants.
ex.zh: 這本書解釋了植物如何受精。

ex.en: Regular fertilization helps the garden grow well.
ex.zh: 定期施肥有助於花園生長良好。

ex.en: The farmer was careful about the fertilization of his fields.
ex.zh: 農夫對田地的施肥非常謹慎。

ex.en: Farmers fertilize the fields before planting corn.
ex.zh: 農夫在種玉米之前會替田地施肥。

ex.en: You should fertilize the lawn twice a year.
ex.zh: 草坪一年應該施肥兩次。

ex.en: Bees help to fertilize the flowers as they move around.
ex.zh: 蜜蜂四處飛動時會幫花朵授粉受精。

ex.en: A sperm cell must fertilize the egg for a baby to grow.
ex.zh: 精子必須使卵子受精，胎兒才會發育。

ex.en: She feigned sleep so she would not have to talk.
ex.zh: 她假裝睡著，這樣就不用說話了。

ex.en: He feigned surprise when we gave him the gift.
ex.zh: 我們送他禮物時，他假裝很驚訝。

felt.zh: 感覺；覺得（feel 的過去式、過去分詞）

ex.en: I felt nervous before the interview.
ex.zh: 面試前我覺得很緊張。

ex.en: She has felt much better since she started exercising.
ex.zh: 自從開始運動，她覺得好多了。

ex.en: The hat is made of soft felt.
ex.zh: 這頂帽子是用柔軟的毛氈做的。

ex.en: She cut shapes out of colored felt for the craft project.
ex.zh: 她把彩色毛氈剪成各種形狀來做手工。

ex.en: She is a fervent supporter of the local team.
ex.zh: 她是當地球隊的熱情支持者。

ex.en: They made a fervent wish for peace.
ex.zh: 他們熱切地祈願和平。

ex.en: The lion defended its territory with great ferocity.
ex.zh: 那頭獅子兇猛地保衛自己的地盤。

ex.en: The storm hit the coast with terrible ferocity.
ex.zh: 風暴以可怕的猛烈程度襲擊海岸。

ex.en: A federalist believes in a strong central government.
ex.zh: 聯邦制擁護者相信強大的中央政府。

ex.en: He described himself as a federalist in the debate.
ex.zh: 他在辯論中稱自己是聯邦制的支持者。

ex.en: Federalism divides power between the national and state governments.
ex.zh: 聯邦制把權力分給中央政府和各州政府。

ex.en: The class discussed how federalism works in different countries.
ex.zh: 班上討論了聯邦制在不同國家如何運作。

ex.en: The child felt feverish and was sent home from school.
ex.zh: 那孩子覺得發燒，被送回家了。

ex.en: There was a feverish rush to finish the project before the deadline.
ex.zh: 大家在期限前瘋狂趕工完成專案。

ex.en: The film featured a famous actor in the lead role.
ex.zh: 這部電影由一位知名演員擔綱主角。

ex.en: Her photos were featured in a travel magazine last month.
ex.zh: 她的照片上個月刊登在一本旅遊雜誌上。

ex.en: Check out the featured recipe on our homepage today.
ex.zh: 來看看我們首頁今天的精選食譜。

ex.en: The featured artist this month is a young painter from Tainan.
ex.zh: 本月的主打藝術家是一位來自台南的年輕畫家。

ex.en: She fervently hoped that her son would come home safely.
ex.zh: 她熱切地盼望兒子能平安回家。

ex.en: The fans fervently cheered for their team.
ex.zh: 球迷們熱烈地為自己的球隊加油。

ex.en: Doctors tested a fecal sample from the patient.
ex.zh: 醫生檢驗了病人的糞便樣本。

ex.en: Fecal matter can pollute rivers and spread disease.
ex.zh: 糞便會污染河川並傳播疾病。

ex.en: The feisty little dog barked at the big one.
ex.zh: 那隻好鬥的小狗對著大狗吠叫。

ex.en: My grandmother is still feisty at ninety.
ex.zh: 我奶奶九十歲了仍然精神抖擻、不服輸。

ex.en: Feral cats live behind the restaurant.
ex.zh: 野貓住在餐廳後面。

ex.en: The farm was overrun by feral pigs.
ex.zh: 農場被野豬佔據。

ex.en: The feathered hat was decorated with bright colors.
ex.zh: 這頂有羽毛的帽子裝飾著鮮豔的色彩。

ex.en: Feathered friends visit our garden every morning.
ex.zh: 每天早上都有鳥兒來我們的花園。

ex.en: She sprinkled feta over the salad.
ex.zh: 她在沙拉上撒了菲達羊乳酪。

ex.en: Feta cheese is salty and a little crumbly.
ex.zh: 菲達乳酪鹹鹹的，質地有點鬆散。

ex.en: The doctor asked for a sample of his feces for testing.
ex.zh: 醫生要他提供糞便樣本做檢驗。

ex.en: Animal feces can carry harmful bacteria.
ex.zh: 動物的糞便可能帶有有害細菌。

ex.en: Corn is used as a feedstock for making fuel.
ex.zh: 玉米被當作製造燃料的原料。

ex.en: The factory needs a steady supply of feedstock.
ex.zh: 這家工廠需要穩定的原料供應。

ex.en: Fermentation turns grape juice into wine.
ex.zh: 發酵作用把葡萄汁變成葡萄酒。

ex.en: Yogurt is made through the fermentation of milk.
ex.zh: 優格是靠牛奶發酵製成的。

ex.en: Feudalism was common in medieval Europe.
ex.zh: 封建制度在中世紀的歐洲很常見。

ex.en: Under feudalism, peasants worked the land for a lord.
ex.zh: 在封建制度下，農民為領主耕作土地。

ex.en: He's a friendly feller who always says hello.
ex.zh: 他是個友善的傢伙，總是會打招呼。

ex.en: That old feller next door knows everyone in town.
ex.zh: 隔壁那個老傢伙認識鎮上每個人。

ex.en: The feller swung his axe and the tree began to lean.
ex.zh: 伐木工人揮動斧頭，樹開始傾斜。

ex.en: A skilled feller can bring down a tree in a chosen direction.
ex.zh: 熟練的伐木工人能讓樹朝指定的方向倒下。

ex.en: They festooned the hall with colorful lights for the party.
ex.zh: 他們用彩色燈飾把大廳裝飾起來準備派對。

ex.en: The streets were festooned with flags on the national holiday.
ex.zh: 國慶日當天街道上掛滿了旗幟作為裝飾。

ex.en: A festoon of flowers hung above the door.
ex.zh: 一串花彩掛在門的上方。

ex.en: The tree was covered in a festoon of lights.
ex.zh: 那棵樹上掛滿了一串串的燈飾。

feared.zh: 害怕；擔心（fear 的過去式）

ex.en: The villagers feared the storm would destroy their homes.
ex.zh: 村民擔心風暴會摧毀他們的房子。

ex.en: As a child, she feared the dark.
ex.zh: 小時候她很怕黑。

ex.en: He was a feared leader whom no one dared to argue with.
ex.zh: 他是個令人畏懼的領導者，沒人敢跟他爭辯。

ex.en: The feared storm never arrived.
ex.zh: 那場令人擔憂的暴風雨始終沒有來。

ex.en: Grapes ferment to become wine.
ex.zh: 葡萄經過發酵會變成葡萄酒。

ex.en: The cabbage needs a few days to ferment into kimchi.
ex.zh: 高麗菜需要幾天發酵才會變成泡菜。

ex.en: The country was in a state of political ferment.
ex.zh: 那個國家處於政治動盪之中。

ex.en: The new law threw the town into ferment.
ex.zh: 新法律讓整個城鎮陷入騷動。

feathery.zh: 羽毛般輕柔的；有羽毛的

ex.en: The cake had a light, feathery texture.
ex.zh: 這個蛋糕口感輕盈蓬鬆。

ex.en: Feathery clouds drifted across the blue sky.
ex.zh: 羽毛般的雲朵飄過藍天。

ex.en: The femur is the longest bone in the human body.
ex.zh: 股骨是人體最長的骨頭。

ex.en: He broke his femur in a skiing accident.
ex.zh: 他在滑雪意外中摔斷了股骨。

ex.en: She looked fetching in her new red hat.
ex.zh: 她戴著新的紅帽子，看起來很迷人。

ex.en: He wore a fetching smile when he opened the door.
ex.zh: 他開門時帶著迷人的笑容。

ex.en: She worked feverishly to finish the report before midnight.
ex.zh: 她拚命趕工，想在午夜前完成報告。

ex.en: The students searched feverishly for their missing keys.
ex.zh: 學生們慌忙地尋找不見的鑰匙。

ex.en: The featureless gray building was hard to remember.
ex.zh: 那棟毫無特色的灰色建築很難讓人記住。

ex.en: We walked across a flat, featureless desert.
ex.zh: 我們走過一片平坦又沒有特色的沙漠。

ex.en: He wore a gray fedora and a long coat.
ex.zh: 他戴著灰色軟呢帽，穿著長大衣。

ex.en: The detective in the old movie always had a fedora.
ex.zh: 那部老電影裡的偵探總是戴著軟呢帽。

ex.en: The cat moved with feline grace across the room.
ex.zh: 那隻貓以優雅的姿態穿過房間。

ex.en: Lions and tigers are large feline predators.
ex.zh: 獅子和老虎是大型的貓科掠食動物。

ex.en: The vet specializes in treating felines.
ex.zh: 這位獸醫專門治療貓科動物。

ex.en: The zoo has a new exhibit featuring wild felines from Asia.
ex.zh: 動物園有個新展區展出來自亞洲的野生貓科動物。

ex.en: The village holds a summer fete to raise money for the school.
ex.zh: 村子每年夏天舉辦園遊會為學校籌款。

ex.en: Children enjoyed games and cake at the fete.
ex.zh: 孩子們在園遊會上玩遊戲、吃蛋糕，玩得很開心。

ex.en: The town feted the returning team with a big parade.
ex.zh: 全鎮用盛大的遊行來歡迎凱旋的球隊。

ex.en: The writer was feted by critics after her book came out.
ex.zh: 她的書出版後，這位作家受到評論家的盛讚。
